Named Mummy, Papa, and sometimes Bhaiya as family members.
Described Mummy cooking and studying with them.
Described Papa going to the office and Bhaiya playing cricket with them.
Discussed ways family members help, including preparing food and taking Dadi to hospital.
Lesson stopped at the child's request; teach-back was not completed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised naming family members and describing how they care for and help one another. Trisha gave examples such as Mummy cooking and studying with them, Papa taking leave, and Bhaiya playing cricket; they were less certain about some examples of helping Dadi. At home, ask Trisha to name one family member and one way that person helps each day.
